name: Kurbağa
scene: An elegant crouching frog rests among flowing pond ripples and tall reeds.
notes: Design sheet only; target 85–125 panes. Frog uses emerald and lime; reeds and pond use cobalt and turquoise. Generated with ClaiFace image using fox and poppy design references and the old frog as subject reference. Visually inspected both generations; one corrective regeneration removed green background reeds and restored white exterior. Remaining doubts for tracing: slight fill variation persists, some same-colour neighbours may merge, and close junctions around folded limbs, toes and reed tips need geometry review. Pane count and production geometry audit are not certified by this design sheet.
